title: The playground gets a proper front door
summary:
A small access-and-usability day: smoother playground login, permission-aware model discovery, live page translation, and a tidier repo.

The playground now has a login flow, alongside redirect-based authentication using temporary API keys. Apps can move people through auth without making them juggle credentials in the open.

The /models endpoints can filter results by API key permissions, so clients see the models available to the credentials they actually brought.

Per-page translation now includes a live status indicator, while the monorepo root got cleared of stray files. One makes the interface more legible; the other makes finding things slightly less archaeological.
